scope: Compile declared acyclic message workflows and exact-value tracking into observable event subgraphs. This is not workflow discovery, semantic leak detection, authenticated delivery or a safety guarantee.

knowledge.meaning: Existing privacy catalogue motivates tracking content, recipients and permitted uses. It does not prove the chosen conditional probability law or make task relevance an authorization.

templates.meaning: Already available configured source; missing content stays unknown.
One complete preparation message, with explicitly declared input routes.
One complete worker message; occurrence does not establish adoption.
One complete reviewer message; occurrence is not an approval or rejection verdict.
One complete publisher message; policy is evaluated separately from occurrence.
